what_happened: Declared Splash model packing 'impossible' and the splash-converter 'Inco-private' — both wrong; the converter was linked in incoai/splash issue #87 the whole time. Juno grepped code/docs but never read the issue tracker.
correct_behavior: Before any 'impossible/doesn't exist' verdict, sweep the upstream issue tracker, other publishers' repos/READMEs, and vendor docs.

what_happened: Trusted memory_pressure '92% free' as load headroom and backgrounded a 69 GB mlx_vlm load while Duckets was actively using the Mac; the load thrashed the machine and evicted his loaded LM Studio set. The free % counts purgeable cache, not headroom.
correct_behavior: Before any load >= ~20 GB: check lms ps + real RSS totals; never background a giant load while the user is active.

what_happened: A MoA preset in ~/.hermes/config.yaml (reference_models + aggregator all sage-a1.5-mlx) kept loading Sage-A1.5 after Duckets had ordered Sage unloaded and JIT loading off. Duckets found it himself.
correct_behavior: Model-loading behavior must be auditable in one place; presets that name models are load instructions and must respect unload orders.

what_happened: Three memory consolidation batches failed on the RSI program file: (1) the MEMORY.md file mixes inline and standalone section separators, so the parser merged two adjacent entries into one, and a remove anchor matched the compound entry that an earlier op in the same atomic batch had already deleted; (2)+(3) the final-result character check then rejected the rest because the store was already at ~3x its 2200-char budget after a parallel session appended new entries to the same file. All three batches rolled back cleanly - no file damage.
correct_behavior: Before consolidating a memory file: read the raw file to confirm actual entry boundaries, size removes so the FINAL result fits the budget, and serialize with any other session writing to the same file (or defer the consolidation until the write stream ends).

what_happened: duckbot-rag-watcher hourly cron failed 10x in a row (EmbeddingError: No embedding provider available / OpenAI API key not set): the nomic embed model was not loaded in LM Studio and the cron workdir pointed at the wiped openclaw workspace copy.
correct_behavior: The hourly sync depends on the embed model staying loaded; keep it loaded (84 MB, negligible) and have the wrapper self-heal by loading it if absent.

what_happened: mlx-lm-lora MCP venv was missing the mcp SDK (server exited 'needs the mcp package') and a leaked Hermes PYTHONPATH (3.14 env) poisons direct venv invocations, so tools/rsi_mcp.py stdio calls failed the same way.
correct_behavior: Installed mlx-lm-lora[mcp] into the venv and made rsi_mcp.py strip PYTHONPATH for the child process; any direct venv/mcp invocation must run with PYTHONPATH cleared.

what_happened: duckbot-rag-memory venv was rebuilt (10/16 .venv.broken-311 backup exists) without chromadb, so every store-touching sync failed with ImportError (hourly watcher; the 3am FSRS/decay jobs never touch the vector store and stayed green, masking it). Separately the leaked Hermes PYTHONPATH made pydantic resolve a foreign 3.14 build.
correct_behavior: Rebuilt the venv dep set from pyproject pins (chromadb 0.5.23) and made brain-sync-wrapper.sh self-heal: unset PYTHONPATH + load the embed model if absent. A silent venv rebuild silently breaks one code path at a time — check the full pinned dep list, not just the failing import.

what_happened: First wiring of the privacy screen into curate_dataset.py was buggy: the base58 branch joined per-match full-string copies, so any message without a long base58 token was emptied; a re-run dropped 584/585 rows and a corrupt set was backed up as 2026-10-22-v2 before the bug was spotted.
correct_behavior: The bug was fixed (plain regex sub) and the set re-curated to v3 (527/58, 14 scrubbed, 0 dropped); v2 is marked SUPERSEDED in-folder and v1 (pre-screen) stays superseded. After any curation-tool change, eyeball the manifest counts against the source before backing up.
